system_description.narrative_title: Russia-Ukraine escalation and Europe’s security-political crisis
system_description.narrative_summary: A rapid escalation of Russian military and hybrid operations against Ukraine is driving a broader European security crisis, forcing allied responses across military, political and economic domains. The violence (new missile types, air and bridge strikes, threats to NATO states) is producing electoral effects, urgent diplomatic maneuvers, conditional funding debates, and market/energy adjustments that ripple beyond the battlefield. The system is open: kinetic escalation, hybrid attack threats, economic linkages and political fallout interact and co-evolve.
system_description.scope: Military escalation by Russia against Ukraine and the resulting European security, political and economic responses — including NATO/EU posture, hybrid attacks (drones, strikes, threats to NATO), Ukraine's countermeasures, sanctions/financial flows, energy and critical-minerals deals, and regional electoral/political effects.
system_description.super_system: The international security and geopolitical order (great-power competition, NATO/EU collective defence, global markets and diplomatic institutions).
adjacent_subsystems: Global energy and commodity markets (oil, potash, critical minerals)
Information warfare and hybrid operations (drones, propaganda, sanctions circumvention)

variables.name: Kinetic attack intensity
variables.description: Measures the rate, scale and lethality of direct physical military strikes and manoeuvres across the theatre.

variables.name: Hybrid attack level
variables.description: Measures the frequency and severity of ambiguous and non-kinetic operations such as drone incursions, cyber intrusions, sabotage and coercive threats.

variables.name: Alliance cohesion
variables.description: Measures the degree of coordinated political, military and diplomatic alignment among cooperating actors in the security framework.

variables.name: Domestic political support
variables.description: Measures aggregate public and elite willingness within societies to authorize, sustain or oppose measures related to the conflict (military, economic, diplomatic).

variables.name: Military capability balance
variables.description: Measures the relative aggregate combat power, readiness and logistical strength between opposing armed forces.

variables.name: Adherence to laws of armed conflict
variables.description: Measures the extent to which combatants comply with international humanitarian norms, targeting restrictions and protection of civilians.

variables.name: Critical infrastructure vulnerability
variables.description: Measures the susceptibility of transport, energy, communications and logistics nodes to disruption or damage from hostile actions.

variables.name: Energy supply disruption
variables.description: Measures the degree and persistence of interruptions, rerouting and price volatility in energy flows resulting from the crisis.

variables.name: Financial flow constraints
variables.description: Measures the extent of restrictions on capital movements, banking connectivity, foreign investment and transactional access tied to the conflict.

variables.name: Defense funding commitments
variables.description: Measures the volume and tempo of pledged and actually disbursed financial resources for defense and security purposes by supporting actors.

variables.name: Economic sanctions pressure
variables.description: Measures the intensity, scope and enforcement effectiveness of economic punitive measures deployed in response to hostile actions.

variables.name: Election and political volatility
variables.description: Measures variability in electoral outcomes, party alignments and government stability driven by the security crisis.

variables.name: Population displacement rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which civilians are uprooted, cross borders or become internally displaced due to the conflict.

variables.name: Information warfare intensity
variables.description: Measures the scale and pervasiveness of coordinated propaganda, disinformation, influence operations and narrative competition.

variables.name: Defense supply resilience
variables.description: Measures robustness of supply chains for military materiel and critical inputs, including redundancy and adaptive sourcing capacity.

variables.name: Military-technology proliferation rate
variables.description: Measures the rate and breadth of transfer or diffusion of weapons, dual-use technologies and delivery systems between actors.

catalysts.title: Intensified Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure
catalysts.description: Ongoing campaign of mass strikes targeting bridges, ports and energy nodes around Kyiv and across Ukraine, likely to continue in the near term.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Russia to intensify strikes', repeated 'Russia hits Kyiv bridge', 'hits Odesa ship', 'pledges massive strikes on Kyiv'.

catalysts.title: Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries
catalysts.description: Kyiv's stated intent to hit Russian refineries underpins a near-term risk of cross-border strikes against energy infrastructure.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Ukraine will hit Russian refineries in response to Moscow's "new doctrine" of airstrikes'.

catalysts.title: Surge in hybrid attacks and drone incursions
catalysts.description: Suspected drone incidents (airport scramble in Vilnius) and warnings from European leaders point to near-term increases in ambiguous hybrid attacks.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Europe braces for "severe hybrid attacks"', 'Lithuania closed Vilnius airport, scrambled NATO jets', 'drone incursions'.

catalysts.title: Bosnia national elections
catalysts.description: Bosnia holds nationwide elections that could change EU accession prospects and influence balances in the Western Balkans.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Bosnia votes Sunday in election that could affect EU bid'.

catalysts.title: Latvia governing coalition formation
catalysts.description: Post-election coalition talks will determine Latvia's trajectory on Ukraine support and messaging in the EU/NATO context.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Latvian PM on track to lead pro-Ukraine coalition', 'Latvians vote in election in shadow of drone incursions'.

catalysts.title: Russian transfer of jet-drone tech to North Korea
catalysts.description: Allegations that Russia shared jet-drone technology with North Korea imply near-term proliferation and expanded strike capabilities for third parties.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Ukraine believes Russia shared jet-drone technology with North Korea, says Zelenskiy'.

catalysts.title: US‑Ukrainian critical minerals investment rollout
catalysts.description: First deal by a US‑Ukrainian fund to secure critical minerals could bolster Ukraine's defense supply chains and industrial base in coming months.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US-Ukrainian investment fund seals first critical minerals deal'.

catalysts.title: Russian-backed Sahel media expansion
catalysts.description: Sahel juntas launching a TV channel with Russian backing indicates a widening Russian influence and information operations in Africa.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Sahel juntas launch TV channel with Russian backing'.

catalysts.title: US‑Russia talks potentially involving oil deal
catalysts.description: Reported talks between the US and Russia that may include a multi-billion dollar oil component could change sanctions dynamics and economic pressure.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'US-Russia talks on Ukraine involve multi-billion dollar oil deal, NYT reports'.

catalysts.title: Escalation of attacks on Black Sea shipping
catalysts.description: Recent strike on a Liberian-flagged ship in Odesa port raises the prospect of further maritime attacks disrupting trade and port operations.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Russia hits Liberian-flagged ship in Ukraine's Odesa port, kills one'.
